text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: spike in interconnect egress errors for GCP region southamerica-east1 affecting Private deployments connected via Partner Interconnect. Auto-page to network on-call.
Sam: taking this — I'm on-call now. tagging @Maria for partner/physical status, @Sofia for runtime routing checks.
Maria: looking at partner portal and GCP console now. I see repeated BGP flap events on Interconnect-Intf-2, AS path shows peer resetting, timestamps ~ last 5m.
Kevin: support FYI — we already have 2 customer cases open (AcmeHealth, RetailCo) complaining about intermittent failures to on-prem endpoints. Customers see high TCP reset rates.
Sofia: quick checks: our cloud routers show route withdrawal + re-advertise loops. Control plane ok, but data plane errors correlate with interconnect SFP errors in partner logs.
Sam: mitigation plan: (1) move affected customers to VPN fallback where available, (2) enable route dampening on Cloud Router for the flapping prefixes, (3) request partner to escalate and patch physical link. Maria — can you confirm SLA for patch ETA?
Maria: partner acknowledges flapping MPLS circuit, opened ticket 987654. ETA for onsite swap of SFPs ~ 40-50 minutes. They are provisioning temporary path via partner-backup if possible.
Lucas: adding runbook reference for others: /runbooks/networking/gcp-interconnect-flap. Commands I'm running:
```
# check peering state
gcloud compute interconnects describe interconnect-123 --region=southamerica-east1
gcloud compute routers get-status cloud-router-01 --region=southamerica-east1
```
Outputs show interface state: ADMIN_DOWN -> UP -> NOT_CONNECTED cycles.
Sofia: I can push BGP dampening: lowering max-suppress to 30, hold-time to 120 for the session temporarily. Will monitor for unintended route blackholing.
Kevin: I pinged both customers with initial incident note and suggested steps: enable VPN fallback, retry jobs, and the support team will update every 30m.
Support Bot: Customer notice sent to AcmeHealth and RetailCo: "We are investigating connectivity issues to on-prem via Interconnect; temporary VPN fallback recommended."
Sam: operational decision: mark incident P2 due to partial customer impact and active mitigation. Creation of incident ticket: INC-2026-4512.
Maria: partner confirms they can stitch a temporary backup circuit via partner-backup, initiating now. Estimated cutover 15 minutes.
Sofia: after cutover, I'll validate BGP sessions and check for route convergence. If stable, we'll fail traffic back and keep interconnect under observation for 2h.
Lucas: snapshot of the affected prefixes and customers:
- 10.11.0.0/16 (AcmeHealth) - intermittent egress failures
- 172.24.0.0/20 (RetailCo) - high reset rates for DB replication
- 192.168.45.0/24 (BetaBank) - degraded, but VPN already active as fallback
Sam: handover note for next on-call (Sofia): primary mitigation in place (VPN fallback + partner backup cutover). Next steps: verify post-cutover stability, request partner RCA, coordinate customer follow-ups.
Sofia: acknowledged, I'll take the pager for the next 2 hours. Please ping me directly for any regression.
Maria: partner reports cutover started and BGP session re-established on backup link — I'm seeing stable session for last 2 mins.
Sofia: validating: routes now stable, packet loss dropped to <0.5% over 60s window. I'll keep dampening config for 30 more minutes then gradually relax.
Kevin: support will send 1st update to customers noting backup path active and ETA for permanent fix.
Sam: great. tagging :white_check_mark: — continuing to monitor. If partner confirms hardware swap complete, we'll plan controlled failback.
incident-bot: NOTE: pager silence set for Sam as he acknowledged incident.
Maria: partner confirms SFP replaced and testing looks good. They will hand back to NOC in 20m.
Sofia: I'll perform controlled failback sequence in 30m during low traffic window and monitor. Postmortem owners: Maria + Sofia.
Kevin: preparing customer post-incident summary draft. Will share in #support for review.
Sam: closing action items: create RCA doc, update runbook with partner-specific checklist, outreach to customers once RCA ready.
Support Bot: Incident status updated to "Mitigated - Monitoring".
Lucas: logging metrics snapshots and saving to incident folder: s3://redwood-incidents/INC-2026-4512/metrics/
Sofia: final note before handoff: keep dampening enabled for 30m after failback, monitor BGP flaps >3 per 5m as rollback trigger.
Kevin: thanks team. I'll keep customers updated and close support cases once they confirm full recovery. :thumbsup:
